Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <35b29...@news.ip.pt>, Luis P. Duarte <Luis....@ip.pt> wrote:

>I saw the other day a guy playing 2 Increased Strength - consecutive
>to gain +1+1 damage...

>Is this possible? Can i play N consecutive Increased Strength?

>Can i play:
> 2 Skin of Rock to prevent 1+1 damage?
> 2 Pulled Fangs?
> 2 Traps?
> 2 DoB?

Yes. Combat cards, unlike reactions and action modifiers, have no restriction
on number of cards playable per round (barring the existing restriction on
additional strikes, and one cannot cancel one's own maneuvers).

If a vampire with FOR takes 6 damage, he or she may play 3 Skins of Rock,
2 Resiliences, or 6 Indomitabilities, or any combination thereof, as
desired.

The 'stackability' of Pulled Fangs, and, to a lesser extent, Drawing Out the
Beast, is currently under some debate in the froup.

gomi
